content.title: About
content.content: Meatless spinach quiche is a baked tart made with a pastry crust, eggs, cream, and fresh spinach, prepared without any meat. It offers a creamy flavor, the fresh aroma of spinach, and a lightly crisp crust.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Spinach quiche originates from French cuisine, where quiche is traditionally filled with a variety of ingredients.
It is often served as a vegetarian appetizer for breakfast, lunch, or a light dinner.
The crust can be shortcrust or puff pastry, depending on personal preference.
Spinach retains most of its nutrients when briefly cooked.
The meatless version makes the dish suitable for vegetarians and those avoiding red meat.

items.title: Rich in iron
items.content: Spinach provides iron, essential for blood formation and maintaining energy levels.

items.title: Source of vitamin K
items.content: Vitamin K supports blood clotting and bone health.

items.title: Contains antioxidants
items.content: Lutein and zeaxanthin in spinach help protect the eyes from age‑related changes.

items.title: Low in calories
items.content: Thanks to the high vegetable content, the meatless quiche is moderately caloric while being filling.

items.title: Provides protein
items.content: Eggs and cheese in the filling supply a complete animal‑derived protein.

items.title: Egg allergy
items.content: The quiche contains eggs, which can trigger allergic reactions in sensitive individuals.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Cream and cheese can increase sodium levels; monitor added salt.

items.title: Oxalates
items.content: Spinach is high in oxalates, which may contribute to kidney stone formation in predisposed persons.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve the quiche warm or at room temperature, cut into portions. It pairs well with a fresh salad, tomato sauce, or a light yogurt dip.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the cooked quiche in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days. Reheat in the oven or microwave to 180 °C to restore crust crispness if desired.
